title: Open 11.6
creator: CrossFit Games
description: Seven-minute ascending ladder of thrusters at 100/65 lb and chest-to-bar pull-ups: 3 and 3, 6 and 6, 9 and 9 and so on. Score is total reps. Repeated as 12.5 and 18.5, so it is the closest thing the Open has to a signature test. Masters 55+ used 90/55 lb.

source.title: CrossFit Games Open 2011 – Workout 11.6
source.author: CrossFit Games
source.license: Public competition workout; description in our own words

items.name: Ladder 3-6-9… in 7 min
items.note: AMRAP 7: keep adding 3 reps per round (21, 24…) until the clock runs out. Score = total reps.
